summary: Norwegian Foreign Ministry funds and the Fafo cover supported the Oslo back-channel logistics in 1993.
detail: Waage reports that Terje Rød-Larsen arranged the time, place, and transportation; Jan Egeland found money in the Norwegian Foreign Ministry budget to pay the costs; Fafo supplied the logistical cover; and Yair Hirschfeld and Ron Pundak were put on Fafo's payroll. This documents a Norwegian public/organizational funding route for WP4 to reconcile and is not evidence of unexplained US private money.
source_quote: Jan Egeland approved the plan and found money on the Foreign Ministry's budget to pay the bill.
